status: Native numeric draft/commit lifecycle implemented; full Photoshop parity incomplete
implementation: Native AppKit numeric text remains a draft until Return, end editing or Tab; Escape cancels without touching pixels/history.
AppKit performs forward/backward field traversal after commit; native text Undo/Redo remains separate from document history.
A weak active-editor hook commits pending values before shared command/selection/history/save/switch/close-review boundaries, and cancels before read/final close/view retirement.
Commit checks document identity/generation, active layer, tool, field label and current baseline value; disabled controls stay disabled.
Finite complete localized input is parsed and clamped only at commit. Existing current-state X/Y translation and13-point line boxes are retained.
Revalidate document switch/close eligibility after committing pending text; a rejected edit keeps its owning document active/open.
Return and Escape exit an untouched active field; retiring an inactive field does not dismiss a different field editor.
Document and floating-panel windows automatically recalculate the native key-view loop as SwiftUI fields appear or change.
limits: Direct Photoshop reference covers a bounded Properties coordinate workflow, not all numeric tools/preferences.
Arithmetic expressions, unit suffixes, scrubbing, arrow-key stepping and exact invalid-input dialogs remain unqualified or absent.
Native engine coordinate/extents limit inconsistency from086 is not changed.
Other dialog/panel-removal and specialized direct-command boundaries need broader qualification.
Photoshop pre-existing document restoration is waiting for explicit user approval after automatic review rejected Undo.
